title: Jesse Marcel Library posts article about Greg Rogers

tellings.quote: One of the most interesting things was that I I recently found out that the Jesse Marcel Library in Montana >> has put up an article about me in their library.

plain: A NASA doctor named Greg Rogers, who says he saw a UFO in a secret hangar, tells Michels that in 2025 he found out the Jesse Marcel Library in Montana had put up an article about him. The library is named for Jesse Marcel Sr., the military officer who handled debris from the reported 1947 UFO crash near Roswell, New Mexico. For Rogers it is a sign his account has been taken in by people who keep the Roswell story alive.
